payload.core_mechanism_summary: Start with the sum of all powers of 3 up to the smallest exponent p such that the sum >= n. Then greedily try to remove the largest possible power (3^i) while keeping the sum >= n, iterating i downwards.
payload.rationale: The algorithm constructs a good number by a typical greedy bit-clearing technique. Correctness relies on an exchange argument: removing a high power is safe if the remaining sum still meets the bound, because lower powers cannot compensate for a missing high power.
